thesis: 截至18:00 SGT，市场的绑定约束已从“海湾商船受损会否维持Brent在100美元上方”升级为“Hormuz与Bab el-Mandeb两大航道能否同时把能源冲击固化为全球再通胀与更高折现率”：也门胡塞武装在历史截止前已夺取Mocha并推进至Hanish群岛附近，Brent盘中升至105美元以上；英国10年期国债收益率升至5.378%、20年和30年期触及1998年以来高位，说明油价冲击已在全球长端利率中获得更广泛确认。与此同时DXY约98.81、USDJPY约153.70，美元并未出现全面避险飙升，日元与BOJ正常化仍构成独立的carry unwind通道；20:15 SGT的ECB决议与20:30 SGT的美国PPI在截止时仍未公布，是下一轮政策定价的真正裁决。
dominant_narrative: 截至历史信息截止，今天的变化不是单纯把9月9日Morning的“Brent 101美元”再向上延伸，而是能源冲击从Hormuz单一航道扩展到Bab el-Mandeb：Reuters在14:13 SGT前确认胡塞武装夺取Mocha、推进至Hanish群岛附近，沙特因Hormuz受阻而增加对红海线路依赖，使两大关键航道第一次同时进入供应链定价。价格端Brent盘中升至105美元以上，英国10年期国债收益率升至5.378%、20年与30年期分别约5.895%和5.948%，表明能源冲击已经通过通胀与期限溢价传导至全球长端；但DXY约98.81而USDJPY约153.70，美元没有形成单向避险挤兑，BOJ正常化和日元融资成本仍在推动另一条carry unwind链。真正尚未发生的裁决仍是20:15 SGT ECB决议、20:30 SGT美国8月PPI，以及美股随后开盘后的跨资产确认；本回填严格不使用这些截止后的结果。

growth.evidence: 中国8月出口同比+25.0%、进口+28.2%显示外需与贸易韧性，但核心CPI仅1.0%，内需价格仍未同步过热。

inflation.evidence: Brent在历史截止前盘中升至105美元以上，双航道风险提高持续输入型通胀的概率。

earnings.evidence: Oracle与Adobe财报在历史截止时仍待美股盘后公布，不能使用后来实际结果；市场继续关注AI收入转化与资本强度。

liquidity.evidence: 全球长端收益率上升、日元维持强势区间，资金成本与carry稳定性继续收紧。

geopolitics.evidence: 胡塞武装夺取Mocha并推进至Hanish群岛，Hormuz仍受美国-伊朗冲突影响，两大关键航道同时承压。

top_catalysts.event: Houthis seize Mocha and reach Hanish islands, pushing Brent above $105 before the 18:00 SGT cutoff
top_catalysts.what_happened: Reuters reported before the historical cutoff that Houthi forces seized Yemen's Red Sea port of Mocha and reached the Hanish islands area, threatening a route Saudi Arabia increasingly relied on while Hormuz traffic was impaired; Brent rose above $105 per barrel intraday.
top_catalysts.what_changed: The physical-supply risk broadened from Hormuz to a second chokepoint around Bab el-Mandeb, turning a Gulf-centric shock into a two-route energy and shipping constraint.
top_catalysts.why_it_matters: If both chokepoints remain impaired, rerouting, insurance and export-capacity costs can keep crude and refined-product prices elevated for longer and make the inflation impulse less transitory.
top_catalysts.transmission: Bab el-Mandeb + Hormuz disruption → shipping/export capacity → Brent/diesel → inflation expectations → global yields → equity and credit multiples.
top_catalysts.confirmation: Further verified disruption to Red Sea or Hormuz transit, sustained crude above the pre-cutoff highs, or continued evidence that Gulf exports remain materially below normal.
top_catalysts.invalidation: Verified de-escalation and restoration of commercial transit through at least one chokepoint that lowers shipping costs and pulls crude back toward the prior range.

top_catalysts.event: Global bond yields jump as oil shock deepens, with UK 10Y gilts at 5.378% ahead of ECB and U.S. PPI
top_catalysts.event_time_et: 2026-09-10 05:49 EDT Reuters update; ECB/PPI still pending at 06:00 EDT cutoff
top_catalysts.event_time_sgt: 2026-09-10 17:49 SGT Reuters update; ECB/PPI still pending at 18:00 SGT cutoff
top_catalysts.what_happened: Reuters reported UK 10-year gilt yields at 5.378%, their highest since 2007, while 20-year and 30-year yields reached roughly 5.895% and 5.948%, the highest since 1998, as oil traded above $105 and investors awaited the still-unreleased ECB decision and U.S. PPI.
top_catalysts.what_changed: The rate confirmation widened from high U.S. Treasury yields to European long-duration bonds, showing the energy shock was being priced as a broader global inflation and term-premium problem.
top_catalysts.why_it_matters: A synchronized rise in global long yields raises the discount rate for equities and credit even before central banks formally react, increasing the chance that the oil shock becomes a financial-conditions shock.
top_catalysts.transmission: Oil shock → inflation/term premium → UK/EU/U.S. long yields → global discount rates → duration assets and credit spreads.
top_catalysts.confirmation: Post-event rate markets continue to hold near or above the pre-cutoff highs and equity duration underperforms as the oil shock persists.
top_catalysts.invalidation: Soft inflation evidence or clearly dovish central-bank guidance drives a sustained global yield reversal despite still-elevated oil.

top_catalysts.event: BOJ board member Masu says rapid rate hikes may be needed if inflation accelerates, reinforcing September tightening risk
top_catalysts.what_happened: BOJ board member Kazuyuki Masu said the central bank might need to raise rates rapidly if inflation accelerates, with the policy rate at 1% and analysts expecting a possible September increase to 1.25%, reinforcing the normalization signal while USDJPY remained near 153.70.
top_catalysts.what_changed: The Japan tightening story moved beyond market pricing into a fresh board-member warning that the pace of hikes could accelerate if inflation becomes more persistent.
top_catalysts.why_it_matters: Faster BOJ normalization can raise the cost of yen-funded leverage at the same time that oil pushes global yields higher, creating an independent carry-unwind channel that can amplify risk-asset volatility.
top_catalysts.transmission: BOJ normalization → JPY funding cost / repatriation → carry unwind → global leverage reduction → equities, credit and duration volatility.
top_catalysts.confirmation: USDJPY remains materially below early-September levels, BOJ hike pricing stays elevated, and global leveraged assets weaken alongside firmer Japanese yields.
top_catalysts.invalidation: BOJ communication turns materially less hawkish and USDJPY retraces the recent yen rally without broader leverage stress.

bear_case.label: Bear Case
bear_case.trigger: 双航道约束进一步恶化，并被后续偏鹰政策或高通胀数据强化。
bear_case.expected_market_reaction: Brent进一步上冲、全球长端收益率和波动率上升，股票、信用和高杠杆资产同步承压。
bear_case.what_confirms_it: 油价、全球长端和VIX形成持续同向上行，且商业航运继续报告实际损失或停航。
bear_case.what_invalidates_it: 政策或数据推动收益率明显回落，且航运实物流量开始恢复。

upcoming_market_watch.consensus: Market broadly expected a rate increase; exact terminal-path guidance remained uncertain
ORCL revenue about $19.13bn/EPS $1.73; ADBE revenue about $6.69bn/EPS $6.07

top_risks.risk: Hormuz与Bab el-Mandeb同时受扰，把能源冲击从风险溢价升级为持续的双航道实物供应约束
top_risks.why_not_fully_priced: Brent已显著上行，但沙特在Hormuz受阻后更依赖红海替代线路；若Bab el-Mandeb也长期受限，当前市场可能低估运输网络冗余消失的成本。
top_risks.trigger: Mocha/Hanish周边冲突继续扩大、红海商船改道增加，或Hormuz流量继续低于正常水平。
top_risks.transmission: 双航道实物约束→运费/保险/出口能力→Brent与柴油→全球通胀→收益率与风险资产估值。
top_risks.confirmation: Brent维持在历史截止高位附近且新的航运数据确认两条航道均持续受扰。
top_risks.invalidation: 至少一条关键航道出现可验证、持续的商业通行恢复并明显压低油价与运费。

top_risks.risk: ECB与美国PPI若同步偏鹰，会把油价冲击放大为全球收益率与估值的第二轮收紧
top_risks.why_not_fully_priced: 截止时欧洲长端已明显上行，但ECB和PPI实际结果都尚未出现，政策与数据可能进一步放大油价冲击。
top_risks.trigger: ECB措辞强化继续收紧预期且PPI高于预期，或两者任一引发全球收益率新一轮跳升。
top_risks.transmission: 政策/通胀惊喜→欧元区与美国前端→全球长端→股票/信用折现率→风险资产广度。
top_risks.confirmation: ECB/PPI后欧元区和美债收益率同步保持在更高区间，Nasdaq/VIX给出风险传导确认。
top_risks.invalidation: 后续信息明显偏软并推动全球收益率持续回落，即使油价仍高。

top_risks.risk: BOJ更快正常化与日元走强触发carry unwind，放大全球久期与高杠杆资产波动
top_risks.why_not_fully_priced: 市场已经看到日元走强，但Masu首次进一步强调通胀加速时可能需要快速加息，杠杆融资成本的尾部仍可能被低估。
top_risks.trigger: BOJ加息预期继续上升、USDJPY进一步下行或日本长端收益率重新上冲。
top_risks.transmission: BOJ正常化→日元融资成本/回流→carry平仓→全球杠杆下降→股票、信用和久期波动。
top_risks.confirmation: 日元维持强势且高杠杆/高久期资产同步弱化，日本收益率保持高位。
top_risks.invalidation: BOJ明显转鸽且USDJPY重新回到近期高位，同时全球风险资产稳定。

next_catalyst.event: European Central Bank monetary policy decision — 10 September 2026
next_catalyst.consensus: Market broadly expected a rate increase; exact path guidance remained the key uncertainty
next_catalyst.why_it_matters: 这是历史截止后的第一项制度性裁决，且15分钟后美国PPI公布；它将决定已经被油价和英国长端验证的再通胀交易是否进一步进入全球央行政策路径。
next_catalyst.bull_interpretation: 若ECB结果不比市场定价更鹰且全球长端回落，风险资产可把部分油价冲击重新视为事件溢价。
next_catalyst.bear_interpretation: 若ECB强化后续收紧预期并被高PPI叠加，全球久期与信用可能面对同步折现率上调。
